title: Proof of Human Intent: Cryptographically Verifiable Human Approval for AI-Driven Software Development
description: Proof of Human Intent (PoHI) is a protocol that creates cryptographically verifiable proof that a real human approved critical software actions. It combines proof-of-personhood (e.g. World ID zero-knowledge proofs), Git/DID signing, and an append-only transparency log (IETF SCITT) to answer who approved an action, what was approved, and when. This record archives the reference implementation, supporting packages, and the academic paper.
